## Change contract

- [ ] I described the protocol behavior, invariant, or public API effect of this change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests that would fail without the intended behavior.
- [ ] I considered concurrency, cancellation, disposal, malformed input, and cross-platform behavior.
- [ ] I ran `dotnet format PeerSharp.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant unit, integration, interoperability, fuzz, or benchmark checks.
- [ ] I updated the approved public API and changelog when required.
- [ ] I kept unrelated formatting and refactoring out of this change.
